name: ornament-style-color
description: Design polychromatic ornamental patterns grounded in Alexander Speltz's classical ornament taxonomy. Builds on monochrome structural analysis by adding period-authentic color palettes, color-to-motif mapping, and rendering styles suited to painted, illuminated, and glazed ornament. Use when creating decorative designs where color is integral to the tradition (Islamic tilework, illuminated manuscripts, Art Nouveau), exploring how historical periods used color in ornament, or producing colored reference imagery for design, illustration, or educational materials.
